title: Canonical Agent Invocation Contract

acceptance_gates.gate_1_program_owned_agent_call_produces: VERIFIED (Compiling program-bound agent produces single typed AgentInvocation with complete provenance)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_standalone_session_produces_same_: VERIFIED (Compiling standalone session agent produces identical AgentInvocation schema and shape)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_hashes_captured_in_invocation: VERIFIED (Prompt, context capsule sha256, compiled package sha256, model id, and invocation sha256 are captured and verified)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_tool_action_constraints_travel_wi: VERIFIED (Allowed tools and forbidden actions travel deterministically with invocation payload)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_execution_receipt_emitted_and_has: VERIFIED (AgentInvocationRuntime execution emits cryptographically signed AgentInvocationReceipt linking all causal digests)

false_proof_defenses.defense_1_invocation_tampering_hash_drif: BLOCKED (Altered fields or prompt injection causes verify_integrity to fail closed with InvocationIntegrityError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_2_unauthorized_tool_injection: BLOCKED (Ungranted tools or forbidden skill actions raise UnauthorizedToolError at compile and runtime)
false_proof_defenses.defense_3_unauthorized_model_policy_viol: BLOCKED (Requesting an unapproved model family raises UnauthorizedModelError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_4_output_contract_violation: BLOCKED (Unstructured or malformed output failing typed contract schema raises OutputContractViolationError)

limitations: Program-Agent Phase Binding Compiler and Topology Orchestration will be formalized in Mandate M53
Multi-agent collaborative session state synchronization will be expanded in Mandate M54
